messages:
Sarah (product): Heads-up — FinCorp asked for two console features: 1) automated cost-anomaly alerts per-customer/per-api-key 2) token-sparkline per route with clickthrough to traces. They're pushing because they had a 3x spike last week and need SLA visibility.

Jess (sales): +1 from them, priority = business-critical for renewal in Q3. Contact: monica@fincorp.com

Tom (support): Repro steps: query usage by api_key for week 2025-05-12..18 shows spikes. snippet:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood/v1/usage?start=2025-05-12&end=2025-05-18&group_by=api_key,route\"
```
Response sample: {"api_key":"acct-123","route":"/chat","tokens":345672,"cost_usd":412.30}

Rahul (eng): Two quick constraints: we only have token-level attribution in our ingest for the last 90 days; per-request traces are sampled at 1/100 by default. Building real-time anomaly detection + per-key alerting will need offline job or streaming aggregator. Estimated 3-4 weeks for MVP (backend + API + minimal UI). Can we scope MVP?

Nina (data): For anomaly detection, we can use rolling z-score over 7d baseline with rate-limited alerts. Thresholds per-customer is needed. Also we can use sampling to do approximate per-api_key attribution but accuracy varies for small tenants.

Rahul (eng): Suggested incremental plan:
- MVP A) per-route & per-api_key sparkline in console (query builder + link to raw usage) + manual "open trace" link (uses existing trace id when available).
- Stretch B) automated anomaly alerts with per-key thresholds + alert routing (pager/slack/email) + anomaly history page.

Sarah (product): Proposed acceptance criteria for MVP A:
1) UI shows 30/90d token sparklines per-route and per-api_key with hover to show numeric tokens+cost
2) clicking spike opens trace list filtered to that time window
3) API latency for console queries <1s for cached queries, <3s cold 95th
4) no increase in ingest cost >5%
5) rollout with feature flag and canary to 5% tenants. Also need docs + runbook.

Tom (support): Any privacy/regulatory issues? FinCorp needs SOC2 logs retained 12 months.

Nina (data): We'll honor retention if tenant has enterprise plan; UI will show retention policy per-tenant.

Jess (sales): FinCorp ok with staged rollout. Wants ETA for MVP.

Sarah (product): Putting this into roadmap as an observability/cost-sparklines candidate. Priority: P1 for enterprise customers, put in next sprint planning. Owners: Sarah (product), Rahul (eng), Nina (data), Tom (support) for validation. Next steps: Rahul to produce rough tech spec + effort estimate by EOD Fri. @Rahul please.

Rahul (eng): Will send spec and infra cost estimate by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:

Sarah (product): Thanks. Filing as thread. :eyes:
